node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF order-one involution-component exclusion
node.statement: For odd h, h!*Phi_h(rho,c) is divisible by rho*c*(c-1)*(c+1). The order-one chamber already excludes the first three factors, while c=-1 contradicts (c-1)^n=1 on all five official next-to-maximal rows because the order of 2 modulo p=2^q-1 is the odd prime q and n is a power of two. Thus the order-one curve reduces to Psi_7=0 of bidegree (2,4) or Psi_15=0 of bidegree (6,12).
node.notes: Exact analytic component exclusion. The Modal factorization is discovery evidence; the stdlib verifier reconstructs the coefficient polynomials and the official torsion contradiction. The residual order-one curves remain open.
